title: Canonical arrows and normalized data for ordinary finite projective-line duality
statement: For a commutative ring A of universe u+1, a natural number N and hA:(N:A)=0, and schemes of universe u [def-pc-scheme], define the following canonical-arrow interface in the ordinary unbounded etale module derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], using inverse image [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], derived tensor [def-kun-derived-tensor] and the projective line P=ProjectiveLine(S) with projection q [def-nagata-projective-space-base-change]. Write 1_T for the constant A-sheaf in degree zero and L_T for the concrete positive finite Tate sheaf in degree zero [def-asd-finite-etale-tate-sheaf]. Use the scalar Kummer class and its module-derived realization of [def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-kummer-class]. A normalized transport system consists of inverse-image isomorphisms for roots and L_T, normalized by the roots' inclusion in G_m and by the pure-tensor section equation of [lem-asd-etale-finite-twist-pullback]. Use these to define the shifted twisted unit and the adjunct of a derived Chern class. The ordered projection map is the symmetry conjugate specified by [lem-amb-proper-coproducts-projection]; define G_q= Lq^* followed by tensoring on the right with L_P[2]. Define the projective-line exchange using [def-kun-unbounded-exchange] and the exact/left-derived inverse-image comparison, and define the comparison f_P^*G_q -> G_q' f^* from tensor pullback, the inverse-image composition square and the normalized shifted line transport.

proof.text: Name the canonical exact-derived single-degree comparison with the cached embeddings, then compose it with the exact/left-derived inverse-image comparison to obtain ordinaryFiniteSinglePullbackIso. Use this comparison and the cached embedding mapIso in ordinaryFiniteShiftedLinePullback. Unfolding the new definitions recovers the same canonical comparison and shifted transport; no mathematical datum changes.

Construct ordinaryFiniteUnitPullback by the cached ordinaryFiniteSinglePullbackIso followed by ordinaryFiniteSingleFunctor.mapIso of the canonical constant-sheaf comparison. The existing genericConstantIso expands to exactly these factors, so the morphism data are definitionally unchanged; the existing public import is preserved. The shifted-line and exact single-degree comparison equations expose the existing definitions. All equations follow by reflexivity. Reuse the HasSheafify and IsGrothendieckAbelian proposition instances stored in DerivedCategoryModule when elaborating these constructions, so the canonical localization arguments match before taking object maps. The inverse-image functor and every existing public signature remain unchanged.

Specialize the generic shifted-single comparison to the finite Tate line, supplying the existing cached single functors and their canonical comparison explicitly. The constructor applies shift commutation followed by the shifted comparison and coefficient isomorphism, exactly the original composite. Retain the public defining equation with its original reflexivity proof.
